art_note: The model shot features a flat graphic overlay rather than high-end campaign lighting, reducing overall luxury appeal.
desc_en: A modern silhouette defined by clean lines and contemporary proportions. This cropped piece features short sleeves and a round neck, offering versatility and effortless elegance for any occasion. Crafted with attention to detail, it brings a touch of understated sophistication to your daily wardrobe. Each piece is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta moderna definida por líneas depuradas y proporciones contemporáneas. Esta pieza de corte corto presenta mangas cortas y cuello redondo, ofreciendo versatilidad y elegancia relajada para cualquier ocasión. Confeccionada con atención al detalle, aporta un toque de sofisticación discreta a tu guardarropa diario. Cada prenda se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío a todo el mundo.
